Foundation Panel 的功能更新，随 Foundation Sunshine 安装包一起提供。
A feature update of the Foundation Panel, shipped with the Foundation Sunshine installer.

- 全新支持 USB/IP 一键修复：未安装、版本不配套、旧版或完整版残留、AMD 主板 USB 异常、系统安全策略拦截等情况，都可在 USB 转发页一键处理，完成后即可继续串流。
  New one-click USB/IP repair: a missing or mismatched install, leftovers of an older or full edition, AMD motherboard USB issues and blocking security policies are all handled from the USB forwarding page, and streaming resumes when it is done.
- 客户端请求配对时弹出全屏 PIN 输入，可直接用键盘、触屏或手柄输入。
  A pairing request now opens a full-screen PIN entry; type the PIN with the keyboard, touch or a controller.
- 所有通知均可点击：配对通知打开 PIN 输入，其他通知打开对应页面，从通知中心点击同样有效。
  Every notification is clickable: a pairing notification opens the PIN entry, others open the matching page, including from the notification centre.
- 剪贴板同步状态可直达主机端开关，并区分主机未开启的情况。
  The clipboard sync status links straight to the host setting and tells you when the host has it turned off.
- 修复更新时可能下载到旧版本安装包、提示文件大小不符的问题。
  Fixes an update that could download an older installer and report a file size mismatch.
- 修复触屏长按托盘图标不弹出菜单的问题。
  Fixes a touch long-press on the tray icon not opening the menu.

本发行版的 `sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` 供 Foundation Sunshine 打包使用；单独使用请安装 [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest)。
`sunshine-gui-windows-x64.zip` in this release is used by Foundation Sunshine's packaging; to use the panel, install [Foundation Sunshine](https://github.com/AlkaidLab/foundation-sunshine/releases/latest).
